text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Fine-san, you're really here...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Could it be that I wasn't the one you 
were calling for?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! That's not it! I just thought I 
wouldn't be able to run with you anymore!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm flattered. However... I will not hold 
back!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You don't have to~. Because I'm sure...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Holding back against this opponent might 
not work... or maybe it will? Just 
kidding♪"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...! Fufu, that makes me even happier.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I can look forward to seeing Fine-san 
running with all her might, right?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Make sure to have fun, Scarlet-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Here I am♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I know. Do I look like some idiot who 
doesn't even check the race card?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's the thing. I wanted it to be a 
surprise, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Why are you here? Your race is already 
over.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I came to see you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu, just kidding~. Did your heart 
skip a beat?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to run them all from the start. 
If the opportunity presents itself and the 
conditioning aligns, of course I'm going 
to run, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Shakur. I'm sure this will be the end of 
my racing."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I was really hoping you would add some 
flair to the occasion, though..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Declaring herself the main star, huh? Just 
as expected of Her Highness.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If you're content with just being a 
supporting character, that's fine by me, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"And yet... you intend to struggle against 
the script written by the gods, don't 
you?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I told you, didn't I? I'm gonna blow 
everyone's minds.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Especially you, Fine. There's no way... 
I'm lettin' you go home like this.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how far you pull ahead... Keep 
your eyes on me, Fine!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I am always watching over you. 
However..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In a race, I only look straight ahead. If 
I fail to notice you, do forgive me♪
